ignoreCommand: case "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" in preview/pr-*) case "${VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF#preview/pr-}" in ''|*[!0-9]*) exit 0 ;; esac; if printf '%s' "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{40}$' && git cat-file -e "${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then git diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD -- .; else exit 1; fi ;; preview/*) exit 0 ;; *) git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- . ../../config/factory.release-policy.v1.json ;; esac
